newsitem.title: UKRAINE: FORECAST-Ukraine Q1 GDP to drop 4.8 pct yr/yr-PM.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ukraine Q1 GDP to drop 4.8 pct yr/yr-PM.

text.p: Ukraine's gross domestic product (GDP) in the first quarter of this year will be 4.8 percent lower than in the same period last year, but GDP over the whole year should rise 0.5-1.0 percent, Prime Minister Vsaid on Tuesday.

"For the first three months we will see GDP fall by 4.8 percent, it will fall by 1.6 percent in the first half of the year, but by the end of the year we should see growth of 0.5 to one percent," C told parliament.
"If we can overcome current economic conditions, it would be great if we could forecast growth in production for the first time in six years," Lazarenko said.
He said Ukraine could see growth providing parliament passes a package of tax reforms and the 1997 budget this month.
